::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Semiconductor services company founded 2018 by Vijay Gudi, based in a Tier-II Indian city (not disclosed on its own site). Started as a design-services shop, redirected toward its own product development during the pandemic.
:::

## What does this firm design?

SoC/ASIC chipsets and embedded products for wireless/IoT, mechatronics, medical devices, environmental monitoring, and electric/autonomous-vehicle applications — has launched two embedded products and two test chips to date.
